body.intent: Fix A run queued by hand (rhiza run start <cs> --workflow plan --autonomous) does not get the daemon's own permission mode: the CLI refuses --permission-mode bypassPermissions, and with none the builtin plan's interview step is refused ('agent step with no permission mode'), so a queued plan run must pick a weaker mode. On 2026-11-13 ~00:40 plan run 01M796JBG1 (change set 01M76XR5, queued with --permission-mode acceptEdits) stopped at its first shell command on a permission prompt (inbox 84109a8). rhiza run abandon then refused it ('running in another process'), so the orchestrator killed its driver and agent by PID, abandoned it, and requeued with --permission-mode auto (run 01M796PA86, works). Wanted: a run the daemon drives takes rhiza.daemon.permissionMode when the start names none (the daemon's own picks already do), so an owner or orchestrator can queue plan runs for accepted no-leaves change sets without choosing a mode.
